title: Nova Spectral AI Raises ₹21.2 Cr To Build Indigenous Infrared Sensor Chips
script:
Nova Spectral AI just raised ₹21.2 Cr to manufacture infrared sensor chips in India.
Shastra VC led this seed round to accelerate local production of critical sensor hardware.
The Bengaluru startup is now scaling its R&D and local manufacturing capabilities.
Founders Anish Priyadarshi and Sanjeev Kumar are actively bridging semiconductor supply chain gaps.
These sensors provide essential infrared imaging for defense and industrial monitoring tasks.
Would you trust domestically produced sensors for your critical defense and industrial gear?
